result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but a few visual issues stand out: a notification badge appears as a detached red dot with no visible container/icon, horizontal carousels clip content at the right edge without clear affordance, and some text is truncated.

issues.description: The notification indicator in the top-right is a bare red dot floating on a faint gray circle with no recognizable icon (e.g., bell), making its purpose unclear and looking like a rendering glitch.
issues.suggestion: Place the red badge on a clearly rendered icon (bell/profile) with a visible tap target, or remove the empty circular background if no icon is intended.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel clips the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right screen edge, and the category chip row also cuts off a chip, with no visible scroll hint or gradient fade.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade/gradient or partial-card peek with consistent padding so users recognize the rows are horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated without an ellipsis, appearing cut off mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis (…) or allow two-line wrapping for card titles.

issues.description: The favorite/heart buttons on cards are icon-only with no visible label, and the red notification dot relies on color alone to convey state.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels (aria-label) to icon buttons and pair the notification color with an icon or count badge.
